Ava (CS Ops): Hi team — I uploaded the onboarding->CRM field crosswalk here: https://docs.redwood/integrations/onboard-crm-crosswalk (sheet: 'v1.2-mapping'). Need owners to confirm gate rules for 'welcome_call' and 'product_setup' before we flip the bridge on Friday.
Diego (Onboard Eng): Looking now. Quick Q: are we treating missing welcome_call as a hard gate (block playbook) or a soft-warning (escalate email)?
Ava (CS Ops): Prefer hard gate for enterprise customers (acct.segment = 'enterprise'), soft for others. Also we need SLA-exempt accounts to bypass the gating — those are in CRM flag `sla_status = 'exempt'`.
Priya (CSM): Confirmed for enterprise. Also ask: if welcome_call scheduled but status not updated, should we fallback to call_scheduled_date? Some teams update only the date.
Diego (Onboard Eng): good call. I'll add logic: if welcome_call_status is null but call_scheduled_date is not null and date > today-14 => treat as completed.
Liam (SRE): Heads-up: the current bridge webhook pushes to /onboard/events. If we add additional gating logic we should do a dry-run mode first (log-only) to avoid stuck queues.
Ava (CS Ops): Agreed. Plan: Wednesday dry-run, Friday toggle. Need Diego to add webhook param `dry_run=true` and a feature flag in our console for the gating rules.
Diego (Onboard Eng): Will add param and feature flag. Also need a small SQL to estimate impact. Running locally now, sharing query:
Diego (Onboard Eng): ```sql
SELECT count(*) AS impacted
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN onboarding o ON o.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.segment = 'enterprise'
  AND a.sla_status != 'exempt'
  AND (o.welcome_call_status IS NULL
       AND (o.call_scheduled_date IS NULL OR o.call_scheduled_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'));
```
Priya (CSM): Can you run that scoped to EMEA pilot first? We have 120 accounts there.
Diego (Onboard Eng): Ran it — impacted = 38 (EMEA pilot). Global impacted = 214.
Ava (CS Ops): Ok that seems safe for dry-run. Liam — can you confirm queue retention and retry settings if we enable gating? We don't want onboarding tasks stuck.
Liam (SRE): Queue retention = 7d, retries = exponential up to 6 attempts. For dry-run it's fine. For enforcement we should add a non-blocking fallback: after 48h mark as "manual review" and ping CSM.
Ava (CS Ops): Good. Action items:
- Diego: add dry_run param, feature flag, and gating code with fallback -> due Wed EOD (owner: Diego)
- Liam: validate queue settings and add 48h fallback -> due Tue EOD (owner: Liam)
- Priya: review crosswalk sheet and flag any product-specific exceptions -> due Tue noon (owner: Priya)
- Ava: schedule dry-run announcement + tracking dashboard widget -> due Tue noon (owner: Ava)
OnboardingBot: Reminder: dry-run feature flag has no users yet. Use /feature enable for test orgs only.
Priya (CSM): ack, will review and send exceptions list.
Diego (Onboard Eng): I'll post a short runbook in #eng-oncall for rollback steps and a link to the test dashboard once done.
Ava (CS Ops): thanks — looping in execs after results. :thumbsup:
Priya (CSM): +1
Diego (Onboard Eng): will notify when PR is up.
Ava (CS Ops): closing thread for now, will reopen with dry-run results."
